German Foreign Minister Wadephul:
Who are we Germans, with our difficult past, to place ourselves on such a high moral pedestal?
Shouldn't we look at the United States with a certain admiration, humility and gratitude?
Who liberated us from the Nazis? The Americans were among them, of course, alongside the British, French and Russians. Ukrainians too, incidentally, as they were part of the Soviet Union at the time.
Who enabled our economic reconstruction, particularly in West Germany? The Americans.
Who trusted in 1989 that reunified Germany would integrate peacefully into the world? The Americans.
In Europe, there were many doubts, for understandable reasons. But the Americans stood behind us and said, "We are giving this Germany another chance."
We must take all of that into account when we sometimes have to take a deep breath, when we get angry or shake our heads.
I see the U.S. as a country that remains connected to us through friendship, both socially and politically, in the long term.
